name: bgready – AI Background Remover for WooCommerce
author: codepower2026

sections.description:
bgready – AI Background Remover for WooCommerce is an AI cutout tool for product photography — it removes backgrounds from WooCommerce product images so you can publish clean cutouts, white or branded backdrops, and marketplace-ready canvases. It is not an image compression or “optimization” plugin: it does not resize/compress your media library to save disk space; it creates new cutout renders via bgready Studio AI.

  • Bulk and automatic background removal when you save a product (featured / gallery images)
  • White, transparent, or custom backgrounds plus marketplace-ready canvas (padding and output size)
  • Soft shadows and optional watermarks on the rendered result
  • Per-product overrides in the product meta box (Process / Reprocess / Restore); originals are always kept
  • Signed job webhooks deliver results without waiting for WP-Cron (polling is only a fallback)
  • WooCommerce → Settings → bgready: API key, defaults, live sample preview, catalogue reprocess
  • Bulk action on Products and Media Library; new attachments named <original>-nobg.png|jpg|webp
  • Respects API rate limits (429 Retry-After) and pauses on insufficient credits (402)

Requires a free or paid bgready account at bgready.com.

Operated by Codepower OÜ (Estonia). Reviewer / ownership contact: info@codepower.io.

External services

This plugin connects to the bgready service to remove backgrounds and render product images.

  • What is sent: product image files you choose to process, render options (background, canvas, watermark, output size/format), and (when you use Test connection / Report a problem) shop URL, WordPress/WooCommerce/plugin versions, and optional feedback text. A signed webhook URL for this site is registered so results can be delivered.
  • When: only after you save an API key and start a process / test / report action. No background telemetry or tracking.
  • Service: https://api.bgready.com/ (and the API base URL you configure)
  • Terms of Service: https://bgready.com/terms/
  • Privacy Policy: https://bgready.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Install from Plugins → Add New, or upload the bgready-background-remover folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin (WooCommerce 8+ must already be active).
  3. Open WooCommerce → Settings → bgready, paste your API key, and click Test connection (registers the signed callback).
  4. Optionally enable automatic processing and tune customisation defaults.
  5. Open a product and use the Background removal (bgready) meta box, or select products / media items and choose Remove background (bgready).

Upgrading from the private 1.5.x zip (bgremove-for-woocommerce): activate this plugin, then deactivate and delete the old one. Your API key and settings are kept (same bgremove_* options). The REST callback path stays /wp-json/bgremove/v1/callback.
sections.faq:
Are original images deleted?

No. Keep original is always on. Results are new Media Library attachments. Restore original switches the product slot back without deleting files.

Does preview cost credits?

Preview downloads are free (≤ ~500×500 px for square). Full-resolution output uses 1 credit per image.

What happens when I run out of credits?

The queue pauses and an admin notice links to the bgready pricing page. Resume after topping up.

Why did nothing change after I saved a new colour?

Existing products keep their old results until you reprocess. After saving settings, use Reprocess catalogue (or Reprocess on a product).

Does this plugin track my shop?

No. It only talks to bgready when you configure an API key and process images (or use Test connection / Report a problem). See External services above.

Who operates this plugin?

Codepower OÜ (Estonia). Ownership / reviewer contact: info@codepower.io.

I already installed the older “bgremove for WooCommerce” zip

Activate this plugin from WordPress.org (or this zip). Settings migrate automatically. Then remove the old plugin folder.
